summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #5. Grounded in the spec actually published by viamin/color_matching (#110, delivered in upstream PR #113): verified upstream sources directly (api_spec.ex, api_schemas.ex, test_sheet_controller.ex, capture_controller.ex, test_sheet_json.ex). Added three permanent Swift test files plus the migration/verification-plan doc. OpenAPIMigrationArtifactsTests are red by design (expected assertion failures demonstrating missing toolchain/vendored spec); OpenAPIClientTests are dormant behind #if canImport(ColorMatchingOpenAPI) until the implementation run lands; APIClientWireContractTests are a green regression net for the wire behavior the generated client must preserve. swift test could not be executed in this Linux container (no Swift toolchain installed; the ColorMatchingLPSApp target requires macOS/iOS SDKs) - the suite runs on the macOS CI runner. Implementation is intentionally out of scope for this phase.
